result.summary: The screen is mostly clean and well structured. The main visible defect is in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, where the first card's time badge overlaps and extends past the food image. A few minor contrast and consistency issues also appear.

issues.description: In the first 'Fastest near you' card (Green Bowl Poké), the '15–25 min' badge overlaps the plate image and looks misaligned. The badge sits over the plate edge and its position looks inconsistent with the other cards, where it sits on a dark background.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the time badges consistently at the bottom-left with the same padding on every card, and make sure they don't collide with the image's focal content.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (delivery fees, 'Ramen', '(500+)') and the placeholder text in the search field have low contrast against the white and light-gray backgrounds. The inactive tab labels are also light gray.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive tab colors to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.description: The promo banner's decorative translucent circles are cut off and the lower one has a hard edge at the bottom-right corner, which looks like a rendering artifact. The white 'Order now' text on the mid-green gradient is also fairly low in contrast at the lighter end.
issues.suggestion: Clip the decorative shapes cleanly within the banner's rounded corners and darken the green gradient for better text contrast.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons are inconsistent. The ramen card's button has a dark circular background, while the pizza card's button has a semi-transparent brown circle with different sizing and offset. The white heart outline also has weak contrast on the light image areas.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent style for the favorite button, with a solid or sufficiently opaque background and the same placement on every card.
